assumptions.recommendation: Two consecutive complete zero-contact windows, then MOVE_CLEAR event, then exactly four complete post windows; primary selection remains unresolved.

limitations: No actual P1 consumer, engine, filesystem writer, gate or operating reseal.
Hashes and code pins are declared consistency, not source authenticity.
Replacing context and all sources coherently is not prevented by an external trust anchor.
S0 fixture semantic slots are dummy declarations, not approved P2 physical mapping.

S0 does not infer actual pair ID semantics, equate LIVE contact counts with payload rows, or recompute LIVE force/velocity/omega from atom payloads; six-object byte binding is not simultaneous physical-state certification.
MOVE_CLEAR diagnostic only; actual mesh deletion is not supported.
First pressure crossing is a sample event, not P1 primary selection or interpolation.
Native contract and post diagnostic do not constitute T12 or physical qualification.
